feedback_interpretation: Observed diethyl malonate elutes much earlier than predicted across measured ratios, refuting transfer from phenyl-substituted malonate. Several ring-nitrogen, β-ketoester, and methoxy-aromatic series show ratio-dependent prediction errors, including sign changes; the selected intermediate and high-ratio points test those patterns. The fluorobenzoate reversal is weak evidence because its measured V2 difference is small. The brominated carboxylic-acid record has V2 below V1 and a negative V2, so it is treated as a data-quality anomaly rather than physical elution evidence. Pending CW16 records have no measured responses.
